name: Soeda Izumi
source:
She is a long-time friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c22147]Renjou Nozomu[/url] and is like a ``neighborhood sister.'' She was actually Nozumu's first love.

She was an athlete when she was a student, and even now she continues to do exercises such as jogging and fitness, and has a slim and toned body.

She is cheerful and cheerful, seemingly always having fun, and often hugs Nozomu unexpectedly or engages in excessive physical contact.

She likes wearing revealing clothes, which seems to be something she does in defiance of her cheating husband.

(Translated from [url=https://erogamescape.dyndns.org/~ap2/ero/toukei_kaiseki/character.php?character=15037]Erogamescape[/url].)
